sprite_sequence.text: No, no, no -- not on the very first day!
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels panicked and flustered, with a burst of frustrated disbelief at being late on the very first day and a strong urge to fix it immediately.
sprite_sequence.label: anxious

sprite_sequence.text: Stupid alarm, why did you die today of all days?!
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She is flustered and panicked, venting frustrated self-blame at the bad timing while trying to keep moving and salvage the morning.
sprite_sequence.label: angry

sprite_sequence.text: Mom's going to say it was fate punishing me for scrolling at midnight...
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She’s flustered and self-mocking, half-panicked about being late but trying to lighten the moment with a joking, resigned complaint.
sprite_sequence.label: embarrassed

sprite_sequence.text: Wait, seriously? They never open this gate.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She’s abruptly shifting from panicked frustration to startled, hopeful curiosity, sensing an unexpected lucky break and mentally grabbing onto it.
sprite_sequence.label: surprised

sprite_sequence.text: Yeah, that was the problem, thanks.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels flustered and defensive, snapping back with embarrassed irritation because she knows the advice is obvious and she’s already stressed about being late.
sprite_sequence.label: angry

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels wary and puzzled, with her earlier panic easing into cautious curiosity as she tries to figure out why the girl knows so much.
sprite_sequence.label: confused

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels startled and suspicious, with a flash of defensive embarrassment at being read so accurately by a stranger.
sprite_sequence.label: surprised

sprite_sequence.text: How do you know that before the board goes up?
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels startled and uneasy, with a sharp spike of suspicion as the girl’s impossible familiarity makes her question what else this stranger knows about her.
sprite_sequence.label: surprised

sprite_sequence.text: Okay, wow. Creepy. Helpful, maybe, but creepy.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She’s startled and uneasy, but trying to regain control with nervous humor and a bold, talkative edge.
sprite_sequence.label: anxious

sprite_sequence.text: Yes! I might actually make it!
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels a sudden burst of relieved, energized optimism as the immediate panic lifts and she sees a real chance of arriving on time.
sprite_sequence.label: smile

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She is jolted into stunned, uneasy disbelief as the near-miss sinks in, with her earlier rush turning into a sharp chill of fear and suspicion.
sprite_sequence.label: surprised

sprite_sequence.text: She said not to use the east stairs.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels a sharp jolt of fear and vindicated alarm, realizing the stranger’s warning may have saved her from something dangerous.
sprite_sequence.label: anxious

sprite_sequence.text: Oh, come on. Don't do this to me on day one.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels a sharp mix of disbelief and rising anxiety, with a frustrated edge because the eerie warning just proved real and she’s suddenly aware she may be caught in something bigger than a bad first day.
sprite_sequence.label: angry

sprite_sequence.text: Fine. School first. Panic attack later.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She is forcing herself into brisk, joking composure to stay functional, while underneath she feels shaken, alarmed, and intensely unsettled by the eerie warning and near-miss.
sprite_sequence.label: determined
